about_the_game:
In Pioneer Racing, the goal is simple: be the best driver! You start with a slow car, and as you win races against Bots, you unlock new cars! Your best lap times are saved, for you to beat them. After a race, you can relax by driving around the map, or customize your car.

This game is still in development, and it has a lot of niew things planned:
-multiplayer, to race against each other, or drive in the same car
-New circuits, with better visuals
-New garage, with more customization to all cars
-New cars, designed with every little detail
-UI update, to match a futuristic look and game design direction
-More instinctive controls, and UI accessibility
-Fix of bugs, like looking around with the mouse
... and much more! Feel free to tell me, for example on my youtube channel, anything you would like to be in the game!
As I'm alone on this game and I try to do everything by myself, updates may take time to come. You can expect one thing to be added each month or less.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: none
  • Additional Notes: game have not been tested under 16GB of ram, contact support for any issue
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible, 7.1 surround sound support recommended
  • VR Support: none

short_description: Choose your car, customize it, and get ready for the race! In this game, you race against AIs with realistic cars and physics, to unlock better cars and beat your lap time! Drive, win and set the best chronos of all times with your favorite car! New functionnalities coming soon...
